messages:
Emma (PM): heads up — sales pushed a contract asking for 'tenant-priority' routing guarantees for AcmeCorp. they want priority routing + a rollback SLA if we fall below their latency SLA. can we draft what we can actually promise? :thinking:
Raj (Eng Lead): rough ask? p50/p95 targets + capacity reservation?
Sophie (C-Success): they asked for p95 < 250ms and a 99.9% uptime for routed requests. also want a credit scheme if we degrade.
Emma (PM): ok noted. proposal sketch: 1) soft reservation (priority queue) with best-effort autoscale 2) hard reservation as paid dedicated allocation 3) rollback/fallback to non-priority model if degraded.
Maria (SRE): technical constraints: soft queue => no strict latency SLO. hard reservation => we can bind GPUs and hit p95 targets but cost/contract implications.
Raj (Eng Lead): agreed. implementation options: a) feature-flagged priority path + token-bucket throttle per tenant b) per-tenant dedicated pool c) hybrid: warm pool + dynamic spillover.
Oliver (Prod Ops): we should codify triggers for automatic failover. suggestion: degrade when p95 > threshold for X minutes OR error rate spikes. also retain canary ramp before cutting traffic over.
Sophie (C-Success): customers will push for automatic credits. Contracts Bot can help with proposed credit tiers.
Contracts Bot: suggested credit templates: "10% monthly credit for single 1-hour SLA breach"; "50% credit for full-day outage impacting >50% of routed requests".
Emma (PM): we need metrics to gate payouts. propose telemetry: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, throughput for tenant routes, and observed spillover counts to fallback.
Maria (SRE): +1. also need distributed tracing markers to attribute time inside priority path vs fallback. add a metric "priority_spill_ratio".
Raj (Eng Lead): here is a quick config snippet for the flag rollout I was imagining:
```json
{
  "flag": "tenant_priority_v1",
  "mode": "gradual",
  "phases": [
    {"pct": 1, "scope": "internal"},
    {"pct": 10, "scope": "beta-tenants"},
    {"pct": 100, "scope": "opt-in-customers"}
  ],
  "fallback": "standard_route",
  "kill_switch": "priority_disable_all"
}
```
Emma (PM): nice. add a canary health check that watches p95 and spill_ratio for 15m windows. fail fast if trends exceed thresholds.
Oliver (Prod Ops): rollout playbook draft: 1) dry-run in staging w/ synthetic load 2) internal 1% 3) beta 10% 4) opt-in customers 100% 5) automated escalation + SE handoff. each step has gating telemetry.
Sophie (C-Success): for AcmeCorp specifically: they want opt-in + contractual escalation path to priority 24/7. ops must be on-call during first 72h of ramp.
Maria (SRE): operational ask: we need an "eviction policy" to quickly shed load from priority path (e.g., oldest/least-recent tokens) and a clear observable for pending-spill.
Raj (Eng Lead): implementation detail: priority queue will be implemented as a lightweight routing tag + KV token bucket tracking per-tenant budget. spillover increments a counter and triggers fallback route which is slower but cheaper.
Emma (PM): negotiation points for legal/sales: - Distinguish "priority" (routing preference) vs "guarantee" (SLA) - Offer two SKUs: Priority-Soft (best-effort) and Priority-Dedicated (contracted SLO) - Define measurable gates and credit calculation formula.
Sophie (C-Success): sales will push for soft at low cost. be ready to show cost delta table.
Contracts Bot: recommended clause language: "Priority routing is provided as either Best-Effort (soft) or Reserved (dedicated). Reserved allocations are backed by capacity pledges and associated SLOs; Best-Effort is not covered by latency SLOs".
Raj (Eng Lead): timeline estimate: soft-priority prototype 2 sprints; token-bucket + telemetry 3 sprints; dedicated pool + billing + legal signoff 6-8 sprints.
Emma (PM): risks: customer expectations mismatch, billing disputes, and untested failure modes causing cascading backpressure. mitigation: run shadow tests, include explicit opt-in acceptance, require SE signoff.
Oliver (Prod Ops): runbook action items (assign): - create rollout dashboard (Oliver) - implement spill_ratio metric (Maria) - prototyping flag config + kill-switch (Raj) - pricing delta and doc for sales (Sophie)
Sophie (C-Success): I'll draft the customer note and the FAQ entry: what happens if priority degrades, how credits are calculated, how to opt-out.
Emma (PM): decision for today: agree to present a two-tier offer (Soft vs Reserved) + a draft rollout/playbook next Wed. any objections?
Raj (Eng Lead): none from eng.
Maria (SRE): fine from SRE, will start metric work.
Oliver (Prod Ops): ok.
Sophie (C-Success): ok, I'll prep negotiation points with pricing.
Contracts Bot: action items logged: create contract appendix template for Priority features.
Emma (PM): thanks all — I'll spin up the GH issue and attach this thread. tagging @se-team for awareness :wave:
Raj (Eng Lead): quick note: add a non-regression check in CI that simulates priority spillover under overloads.
Maria (SRE): +1 — also smoke test tracing propagation for end-to-end attribution.
Emma (PM): last: assign tentative date for first internal dry-run: 2026-04-15. I'll add to calendar.
Sophie (C-Success): ping me when draft pricing is ready, I'll run it by sales.
Oliver (Prod Ops): will create initial dashboard by EOD Friday.
Emma (PM): closing — will follow up with GH link. :lock:
